title: Hierarchical System
text: Classification is hierarchical - each level contains the levels below it. A Kingdom contains many Phyla, each Phylum contains many Classes, and so on down to Species.

title: Memory Aid
text: Use a mnemonic sentence where each word starts with the first letter of the taxonomic level: King Philip Came Over For Good Soup (K-P-C-O-F-G-S for Kingdom-Phylum-Class-Order-Family-Genus-Species).
